route_title: Chirped Thickness Stack for Broadband UV Reflection
compilation_rationale: Compiled 24-layer alternating H/L dielectric stack on fused-silica. Spectral requirements split into 300–450 nm high-reflectance and 1000–1700 nm high-transmittance bands. Normal-incidence coherent TMM with 24 free thickness parameters optimized via gradient-based search.
